abilities.vendor_version_checked: Fluent Forms installed on helenawillow (vendor build dated 2026-04-23; source read live via filesystem/read-file)
abilities.doc: Vendor source verified: app/Services/Form/FormService.php::store, app/Models/Form.php::prepare, app/Models/Traits/PredefinedForms.php::resolvePredefinedForm/findPredefinedForm, vendor framework Support/Arr.php::get
abilities.canonical_handler: Bare: FluentForm\App\Models\Form::prepare() -> (new Form())->create($data) -> save() (the same model write FormService::store uses internally, WITHOUT the admin-only ' (#id)' rename). Template path (template_id supplied): FluentForm\App\Services\Form\FormService::store() (vendor-native predefined-seed + rename + default form-meta).
abilities.notes: Package 3c V3/V9 fix (P3c, Variant A — orchestrator-dispositioned, reviewer-verified against vendor source). Callback-body only; no input_schema/output_schema/annotation change (this is a new v2.0.0 ability, not v1.1.3 Stable-locked: includes/forms/write-abilities.php first added in commit 7891620). DEFECT (F-FORMS-01): the pre-fix callback always routed through FormService::store() and fabricated its return from the INPUT ($title / $attributes['status']). Vendor source proves store() is template-seeded: resolvePredefinedForm() returns the predefined-template structure and carries over only `type` from caller attributes; Form::prepare() then reads title/status/form_fields from the resolved template (defaults title 'My New Form', status 'published') and array_filter() drops empties; store() then unconditionally appends ' (#'.$id.')' to the title. With no `predefined` key, framework Arr::get($map, null) returns the whole template map (no exception) -> persisted 'My New Form (#N)' / published / form_fields:null while the ability returned the operator's input verbatim (V3 read-back violation; V9 returned-id/round-trip mismatch on title/status). FIX: bare create now routes through the vendor public Form model the way FormService uses it internally (Form::prepare([...]) -> model create + save) but WITHOUT the ' (#id)' rename, so declared title/status/form_fields persist verbatim; the template/predefined path keeps FormService::store() (its rename + default meta are vendor-native there). The return is now a read-back of the persisted vendor Form (Form::find), scalar-cast (V5 framework-object boundary: form_id int, title/status string — no Eloquent/Collection state). V10 typed errors: plugin_missing (Form class absent), vendor_precondition_failed (Form::prepare missing on build / read-back fails / FormService::store unavailable on template path), ability_execution_failed (vendor throw or no persisted id). method_exists() is intentionally NOT used to gate create()/find() (WPFluent ORM resolves them via __call/__callStatic; a vendor failure surfaces through try/catch as a typed error). LIVE READ-BACK VERIFIED (2026-05-16, helenawillow, p3c build deployed via SSH then restored to 0fbd3b1 — pre 122210/md5 21d45c34, post-restore 122210/md5 21d45c34; mcp-adapter-execute-ability path, no wp eval/DB, testclient discipline, 0 fixture residue): bare create title='P3C-testclient-bare-1' status='unpublished' -> get-form id=18 persisted title='P3C-testclient-bare-1' (NO ' (#18)'), status='unpublished' == returned; bare create title='P3C-testclient-bare-2' status='published' with form_fields -> get-form id=19 persisted form_fields == provided builder JSON verbatim, title/status == returned; typed-error path: empty title -> typed 'title is required'. Both forms deleted; get-form 18/19 -> 'Form not found' (0 residue). REVIEW ROUND 2 (PR #88): (1) created_by ownership — vendor source proves Form::prepare() builds 'created_by' => get_current_user_id() then array_filter(); FormService::store() sets created_by ONLY via that same Form::prepare() call (no separate assignment), so Variant A's Form::prepare()->create()->save() sets ownership by the IDENTICAL vendor mechanism as the realistic pre-fix path (FormService::store, class_exists always true on FluentForms-active sites) — no ownership regression is structurally possible; the pre-fix explicit $form->created_by in the manual else-branch was the FormService-ABSENT fallback only, off the realistic path. No MCP read ability projects fluentform_forms.created_by (get-form runs SELECT * but returns a fixed field set excluding created_by, and get-form is v1.1.3 Stable-locked — its schema/callback cannot be extended here), so persisted owner is established by vendor source + behavioral parity, not by a reader field. create()+save() mirrors FormService::store() internals (store() itself does $this->model->create($data) then $form->save()). (2) Template path RETURN did change (now flows the shared read-back: persisted '<template> (#id)' title, redirect_url => null) — the earlier 'unchanged' wording is corrected; the WRITE mechanism (FormService::store) is unchanged. LIVE (2026-05-16, helenawillow, mcp-adapter path, testclient, 0 residue): bare title='P3C-tc-owner-bare' status='unpublished' -> get-form id=20 persisted == returned; template_id=1 with title input 'P3C-tc-template' -> create-form RETURN and get-form id=21 BOTH 'My New Form (#21)' / 'published' (vendor-native predefined-seed + ' (#id)' rename via FormService::store; the return is now a truthful read-back, NOT the pre-fix input echo of 'P3C-tc-template'). Forms 20/21 deleted -> 'Form not found'. p3c build deployed via SSH, restored to 0fbd3b1 (122210 B / md5 21d45c341a649b65000353bb4c42db99).
